name: The University of Texas at San Antonio

ipeds.title: IPEDS College Navigator - The University of Texas at San Antonio (expenses)

stats.notes: CDS 2024-2025 (fall 2024 first-years), the newest CDS listed on UTSA's Institutional Research page (a 2025-26 file was not available). C1: 25,422 applicants, 22,063 admitted, 5,980 enrolled. International admit rate 96.5% (442 of 458), 104 enrolled. UTSA left high school GPA (C11/C12) blank, so GPA fields are omitted; 16% of enrollees were in the top tenth and 55% in the top quarter of their class (C10). Undergraduate enrollment 31,127 is CDS B1 total undergraduates; 427 is degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates (B2). Student-faculty ratio 23.8 is CDS I-2 (fall 2024).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS 2024-25 C8A: SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.

cost.notes: IPEDS College Navigator 2024-25 first-time undergraduate expenses: tuition amounts include required fees; on-campus food and housing $14,912. The CDS left section G (costs) blank. CDS 2024-25 H6: 340 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid (avg $6,646, total $2,259,506); the CDS did not mark whether it was need- or non-need-based.
